pl-l4d7c1-d1e115.summary: Turns to the sacrament of confirmation, about whose power the question is usually raised.

pl-l4d7c1-d1e118.summary: States that its form is clear: the words the bishop says when he signs the baptized on the forehead with sacred chrism.
claims: The form of confirmation is the bishop's words with the chrismation of the forehead.

pl-l4d7c1.summary: Turns to confirmation, whose power is in question; its form is clear: the words the bishop says when he signs the baptized on the forehead with sacred chrism.
claims: The form of confirmation is the bishop's words when anointing the forehead with chrism.
